citation: Directive 2005/29/EC Annex I, point 4a; Directive (EU) 2024/825 Recital 9
quote_en: Making a generic environmental claim for which the trader is not able to demonstrate recognised excellent environmental performance relevant to the claim.
explanation_cn: 泛化环保声明，若无法证明与声明相关的公认优秀环境绩效，即属禁止之列。
evidence_needed: 与声明相关的公认优秀环境绩效证明；适用时的认可标签/认证及其范围
rewrite_hint: 改为「XX% 认证材料（认证编号 XXX）」或具体环境属性；删除无依据的泛化词
notes: 引擎需排除非环保含义的搭配：greenhouse gas / green tea / green card / 颜色词 Colour: Green。同一媒介中若已清晰、显著地具体说明该声明的依据，可不属此项禁止。英国侧依 CMA 原则一/二 对应，故 market=Both。

quote_en: Claiming, based on the offsetting of greenhouse gas emissions, that a product has a neutral, reduced or positive impact on the environment in terms of greenhouse gas emissions
explanation_cn: 以「碳抵消」为依据，声称产品在温室气体方面具有中性、减排或正面影响。
evidence_needed: 产品实际温室气体排放数据；核算方法与核算范围（范围1/2/3）；抵消项目名称与登记编号；实际减排与抵消的区分记录
rewrite_hint: 改为「减排 XX kg CO2e（核算范围已披露）」等可核查的实际减排信息，或删除该表述
notes: 仅适用于「基于抵消」的产品声称；企业层面的减排目标不在本条（见未来绩效规则）。原触发词 positive environmental impact 过宽已删除。英国侧依 CMA 原则一/六 同样可判误导，故 market=Both。

citation: Directive 2005/29/EC Annex I, point 10a（经 Directive (EU) 2024/825 新增）；Recital 7
quote_en: Presenting requirements imposed by law on all products within the relevant product category on the Union market as a distinctive feature of the trader’s offer.
explanation_cn: 把该类别在欧盟市场所有产品都必须满足的法律要求，包装成自家的独特优势。
evidence_needed: 该产品类别适用的欧盟法规；证明该要求适用于全部同类产品的法律文件；企业是否另有超出法定义务的环保措施
rewrite_hint: 删除「法定要求」类表述；若要突出优势，改为「超出法定义务的额外措施：XX」
notes: 典型场景：把法规已禁用/已强制的项目（CFC、铅、某些限用物质）当作「我们不含」的卖点。原触发词多为文件语言（legal compliance / EU regulations），已换成文案实际写法。条号已于 2026-11-10 对照合并版 02005L0029-20260927 核实：10a 确为「将法定要求作为卖点」。

quote_en: Presenting a good as allowing repair when it does not.
explanation_cn: 把实际不具备维修能力的商品，宣传为可以维修。
evidence_needed: 产品设计与技术规格；维修测试报告；维修说明书；备件供应情况；维修服务条件
rewrite_hint: 仅在设计与技术特性确实支持维修时才可使用；改为「可更换 XX 部件（备件供应至 20XX 年）」
notes: 已修正原 citation 的重复词（Directive Directive）。删除 repair services，避免误命中售后服务描述。

source_doc: CMA – Fashion greenwashing: investigation into ASOS, Boohoo and Asda (2024)
citation: Undertakings accepted from ASOS, Boohoo and George at Asda – Statements regarding fabrics (27 March 2024)
quote_en: Statements regarding fabrics: Statements made about materials in green ranges must be specific and clear, such as ‘organic’ or ‘recycled’, rather than ambiguous – e.g. using terms like ‘eco’, ‘responsible’, or ‘sustainable’, without further explanation. The percentage of recycled or organic fibres must be clearly displayed and easy for customers to see. A product cannot be called ‘recycled’ or ‘organic’ unless it meets certain criteria.
explanation_cn: 面料声明必须具体（有机棉、再生涤纶），不能用「环保／负责任／可持续」含糊代替；再生或有机纤维的比例必须清楚标示；未达标准不得称「再生」或「有机」。
evidence_needed: 面料成分资料；再生/有机纤维实际含量百分比；供应商材料证明与检测报告；GRS / GOTS / OCS 等认证证书编号
rewrite_hint: 改为「XX% 再生涤纶（GRS 认证编号 XXX）」或「XX% 有机棉（GOTS 编号 XXX）」
notes: 全表最好用的一条，可直接上 demo。已补裸材料词（organic cotton / recycled polyester），原文只有 fibres 组合词，真实文案里常直接写材质名。

source_doc: CMA – Fashion greenwashing: investigation into ASOS, Boohoo and Asda (2024)
citation: Undertakings accepted from ASOS, Boohoo and George at Asda – Criteria for green ranges (27 March 2024)
quote_en: Criteria for green ranges: The criteria used to decide which products are included in environmental collections must be clearly set out and detail any minimum requirements. For example, if products need to contain a certain percentage of recycled fibres to be included in the range, this should be made clear. Products must not be marketed or labelled as part of an environmental range unless they meet all the relevant criteria.
explanation_cn: 必须公布环保系列的入选标准与最低要求（如再生纤维占比）；只有满足全部标准的产品，才能被宣传或标记为环保系列产品。
evidence_needed: 该系列的正式入选标准与最低门槛；产品材料成分与再生含量证明；逐款产品符合标准的记录
rewrite_hint: 补一句「入选标准：再生纤维 ≥XX%，本产品 XX%」，或删除系列名
notes: 已删除原触发词中的 Responsible edit / Ready for the Future / George for Good —— 那是被调查三家企业的专属产品线名，中国卖家文案里不会出现。quote_en 中的品牌举例也已移除。

source_doc: CMA – Fashion greenwashing: investigation into ASOS, Boohoo and Asda (2024)
citation: Undertakings accepted from ASOS, Boohoo and George at Asda – Accreditation schemes (27 March 2024)
quote_en: Accreditation schemes: Statements made by the companies about accreditation schemes and standards must not be misleading. For example, statements must make clear whether an accreditation applies to particular products or to the firm’s wider practices.
explanation_cn: 对认证的宣传不得误导；必须说明该认证是覆盖「特定产品」还是「企业整体经营」。
evidence_needed: 认证证书与有效期；认证机构与标准；认证适用范围（产品 / 企业）的正式文件；证书编号
rewrite_hint: 改为「XX 认证（证书编号 XXX，适用于本产品）」，并明确区分产品认证与企业整体认证
notes: 原触发词全是描述性元语言（accreditation schemes / certification scope），已换成真实会出现的认证名。无证书编号的认证声称一律判「待确认」。

citation: EU 2024/825 Annex I point 4a（泛化环境声称）；CMA 原则二「清晰不含糊」+ 原则六「可举证」
quote_en: Making a generic environmental claim for which the trader is not able to demonstrate recognised excellent environmental performance relevant to the claim. (Annex I, 4a) — Claims should be worded in a way which is transparent and straightforward so consumers can easily understand them. (CMA Principle 2)
explanation_cn: 声称产品可降解／可堆肥，却未说明降解标准、适用环境与时限——属无依据的环境声称。
evidence_needed: 降解标准（EN 13432 / ASTM D6400）、适用环境（工业堆肥／家庭堆肥／土壤／海洋）、降解时限、第三方检测报告
rewrite_hint: 改为「符合 EN 13432 工业可堆肥标准（报告编号 XXX），XX 周内降解」
notes: 欧盟无专门条款，由 Annex I 4a 泛化声称 + 一般误导条款覆盖；英国由 CMA 原则一/二/六覆盖。我们判的是「有没有限定条件和检测依据」，不判「能不能降解」。quote 为两条原文的组合引用。

citation: Green Claims Code, Principle 4: comparisons must be fair and meaningful
quote_en: It is important that consumers are not misled by the way comparative claims are made. Comparisons should be based on clear, up to date and objective information. They should not benefit one product or brand to the detriment of another if the comparison is inaccurate or false.
explanation_cn: 比较性环保声称必须说明比较对象与基准，且依据清晰、最新、客观。
evidence_needed: 比较对象与基准、双方环境绩效数据、测量方法与数据时效
rewrite_hint: 补「相比 XX（基准），本产品 XX 指标低 XX%（测量方法 XXX）」；补不出基准就删除比较
notes: 原为旧版 LR-012，触发词已收紧：删掉 better than（会命中 better than ever）。有基准的比较是合法的，故严重度定 medium。新增 context_terms：只有同句还出现环保词时才算「比较性环保声称」，避免把「darker than conventional white paper」这类普通比较误判为环保比较。
context_terms: environment, environmental, carbon, emission, emissions, co2, recycl, sustain, eco, green, climate, biodegradable, compost, waste, energy
